text: Persist approved aim-subtree proposals safely and idempotently
description: Add a backend approval operation that validates an exact AimProposal revision, checks existing parents and optional phase before writing, pre-generates durable IDs, creates the displayed aims and contribution edges, suppresses duplicate retries with an idempotency key, and reports exact partial progress on write failure. It must not call a model or reinterpret the approved snapshot.

status.comment: Approval persistence is implemented and internally verified; awaiting Felix's acceptance.

reflection: Implemented backend aim.approveAimSubtree using the shared proposal schema. It validates the exact revision and all external references before writes, pre-generates a stable proposal-ID→aim-ID map, persists aims root-to-leaf with contribution metadata, attaches the root to approved existing parents/phase, and journals progress under runtime for safe replay/resumption. It returns exact partial progress on failure rather than claiming atomicity. Verification: focused server tests 24/24, full backend tests 64/64, backend TypeScript build, and git diff check pass.
